edits.old: The harness asserts these rules against the owning services and the published contracts; it does not re-implement them. No BR row is changed by this story.
edits.new:
The harness asserts these rules against the owning services and the published contracts; it does not re-implement them. No BR row is changed by this story.

Open decisions: DL10 is open with assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863; DL26 is open with assumptions ASM-0247, ASM-0264, ASM-0275 and ASM-0355. Each assumption is confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026.

Sources of the timeline items: the state change and creation items are read from the decision records of the case through the rwb-decision decision-record query; no history table is added to rwb_case. A transfer item takes its from queue and from owner from the closed previous assignment row of the same case, and its rule version from the decision record of the transfer.

Document items are read from the case-scoped document read on API-P5-002 of base /api/recovery/document/v1, with the window carried as from and to, inclusive; the items carry at, type DOCUMENT, summary, by, reference and doc_version.
